form.title: Set up your account
form.intro: Set up your account by entering the following information:

profile.businessName: Name of your business or trade

category.label: Select your category

PHYSICAL_PERSON.label: Individual
PHYSICAL_PERSON.description: Individual seller, without a registered legal structure.

category.physicalPersonNote: As an individual, you have no legal documents to provide: you can complete your registration at the next step.
category.formatsNote: Note: SVG, PNG, JPG, PDF or Word format
category.dropOrClick: Drag and drop documents or click to add

legal.title: Legal information
legal.intro: Enter the official information of your company.
legal.sizeHint: MSME classification: {size}. For information only: your category remains the one chosen at the previous step.

activities.title: Company activities
activities.intro: Describe the products, services and activities of your company.
activities.categoriesPlaceholder: Separate categories with a comma or a new line

representative.title: Representative and production resources
representative.intro: Enter the legal representative and the production capacities.
representative.name: Representative's full name

questions.title: Applicable questions
questions.intro: Select the questions that apply to your company. The answers can be completed later.
questions.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# question selected} other {# questions selected}}
questions.otherPlaceholder: Your other questions about exporting or importing

items.q01: What questions should be considered before starting to export?
items.q02: What should the typical export process involve?
items.q03: What are the national export promotion agencies and what services do they provide to exporting companies?
items.q04: In which foreign markets could the product be sold?
items.q05: Where can market studies on specific products be found?
items.q06: How can information on foreign markets be obtained?
items.q07: What are the different ways of accessing foreign markets?
items.q08: What are the different distribution channels used across world markets?
items.q09: What is an Export Development Company (EDC) and how can it help small and medium-sized enterprises with their export activities?
items.q10: Where do trade fairs take place?
items.q11: How to select the right trade fair?
items.q12: How to prepare for a trade fair?
items.q13: What are the costs of taking part in a trade fair?
items.q14: How to make a success of taking part in a trade fair?
items.q15: How can the exporter be represented abroad?
items.q16: How to open a branch in Europe?
items.q17: What customs documents are mandatory for exporting?
items.q19: How to know whether products intended for export meet the quality standards of the target markets?
items.q20: How to set the price of a product intended for export?
items.q21: How to choose the right source of financing?
items.q22: What payment methods are available to the exporter?
items.q23: What guarantees should be required to be sure of being paid by the importer?
items.q24: How can exchange rate risks be managed?
items.q25: Which mode of transport is best suited for shipping the goods?
items.q26: How to help manufacturers sell their products in the markets of neighbouring and landlocked countries?
items.q27: What taxes and fees apply to products intended to be exhibited at international fairs and trade shows?
items.q28: How to get States to comply with the international agreements they have signed and ratified?
items.q29: What bilateral and multilateral trade agreements has your country signed?
items.q30: What protective measures have restrictive effects on your imports?
